# Sarah J Hill — Dragon Fire Design

> Web design for women in business, female founders, charities, community groups and tradeswomen in Cardiff, Birmingham and across the UK. Fixed-price websites you own outright, built so nobody writes you off in the first three seconds. Run by Sarah J Hill, a full-stack developer.

Prices run from about £300 (a simple one-page site) to £4,500+ (bookings, payments and custom business tools), always as a fixed quote agreed before work starts. No monthly rent. Bilingual Welsh/English sites are available.

## Services

- [Web design in Cardiff](https://sarahjhill.com/web-design-cardiff.html): websites for women in business, charities and community groups in Cardiff and the Valleys
- [Web design in Birmingham](https://sarahjhill.com/web-design-birmingham.html): the same for Birmingham and the West Midlands
- [Free website audit](https://sarahjhill.com/website-audit.html): a free review of an existing website, report in two working days
- [The Dragon Fire Process](https://sarahjhill.com/project-os.html): the client portal every project runs through, also licensed to other studios
- [Ember](https://sarahjhill.com/themes.html): a marketplace theme for Shopify and WooCommerce

## Work

- [Cardiff Community Meals](https://sarahjhill.com/cardiff-community-meals.html): bilingual community meals platform, Cardiff
- [Muslim Bookers](https://sarahjhill.com/portfolio-project.html): halal travel booking
- [Emails, posters and campaign media](https://sarahjhill.com/emails-media.html)
